description: This file defines the GuzzleHttp\Pool class, which manages concurrent HTTP requests using a request pool with configurable concurrency. It includes methods for creating request pools, batching requests, and handling request promises.

classes.name: Pool
classes.description: Manages a pool of HTTP requests to be sent concurrently with a maximum concurrency limit, providing methods to create request pools, batch requests, and handle promises.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Pool with a client, requests (or request-generating functions), and configuration options including concurrency and request options.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns the promise associated with the request pool, allowing callers to wait for all requests to complete.

methods.name: batch
methods.description: Executes multiple requests concurrently and returns an array of responses or exceptions, maintaining the order of requests.
